Pre-v2 worker protocol protobuf stubs remain in the monorepo even though no service loads them at runtime.
Delete the unused stubs, regenerate any residual imports, and shrink the worker image layer that still packaged the old descriptors.
Confirm CI no longer runs protoc targets for the retired package.
